input.quote: Customer commits to purchase at least USD 2,000,000 of Services in each of the next three years on a take-or-pay basis, without reduction or termination rights.
input.rationale: No express liquidated damages clause exists, but Section 2.1 imposes an unconditional USD 2,000,000 annual take-or-pay commitment "without reduction or termination rights", so Customer must pay for Services it does not consume even after terminating — economically a Customer-payable penalty/minimum fee, which the playbook prohibits (preferred: no liquidated damages or penalties payable by Customer). It also contradicts Section 12.3, which states Customer has made no minimum-volume commitment. Remedies flowing to Customer (refunds in 10.2, 19.4, 27.3) are unaffected. The redline makes volumes a non-binding forecast and bars shortfall, penalty, and early-termination charges, with a 3-month-fee cap offered as fallback.

proposal.summary: Convert the take-or-pay minimum commitment in 2.1 into a non-binding forecast and confirm no Customer-payable liquidated damages, shortfall, or early-termination charge.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We do not accept liquidated damages, penalties, or take-or-pay shortfall amounts payable by Customer, so we have made the volume figure a non-binding forecast and confirmed no shortfall or early-termination charge applies; this also removes the conflict with Section 12.3, which states Customer has made no minimum-volume commitment. If a committed spend is commercially essential, we can discuss a single early-termination fee capped at three months' Fees as the sole liquidated amount.

ops.oldText: Customer commits to purchase at least USD 2,000,000 of Services in each of the next three years on a take-or-pay basis, without reduction or termination rights.
ops.newText: Any purchase volumes described in this Agreement or an Order Form are non-binding forecasts. Customer is not liable for any take-or-pay or minimum-commitment shortfall, liquidated damages, penalty, or early-termination charge, and Customer's reduction, non-renewal, and termination rights under this Agreement are unaffected.
